question: p-solar
unit: sum (whole 30 kWp array - mounting system, strengthening and design only)

band.unit: sum for the whole 30 kWp / 60 panel array (GST exclusive, Auckland)
band.basis: ADD of distinct components, no aggregate rows used. Mounting system 6,786-13,300; strengthening to one third of the footprint 2,000-4,834; structural design and PS1 2,500-4,000. Total 11,286-22,134, rounded to 11,300-22,100 (mid ~16,700). QV supplied the purlins, bolts and the roofer labour rate; the proprietary rail hardware and the engineer's fees came from fetched NZ pages since QV publishes no PV mounting row. The band is wide because the rail section, the bracket-to-rib interface and the number of new purlins are all the designer's decisions, and because retail list prices carry no trade discount or project margin. Confidence is low for that reason; the main cost drivers are each cited, not allowed.

band.unit: sum (whole 30 kWp array - mounting system, strengthening and design only)
band.basis: GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland, Q4-2026 rates, no preliminaries, margin or electrical work. Mounting priced as QV per-metre aluminium framing (row 5c692a5a...:t0:r5, AKL 40.4/m) x 130-150 m plus QV small-section bolted support framing (row 5c692a5a...:t3:r4, AKL 33.8-54/kg) x 60-100 kg - QV has no proprietary PV rail/clamp row, so both are proxies for a different item and the mounting band is wide for that reason; installation labour is treated as embodied in those two rows' wording and is deliberately not added a second time. Strengthening priced from QV DHS/HST purlin rows (AKL 34.6-38.6/m) x 35-70 m plus QV 12 mm galvanised bolts at AKL 7.9 each. Design priced as fetched NZ consultancy rates ($230/hr senior, $320/hr CPEng, $420 Auckland site visit) x assumed 12-20 h and 2-3 h. Sanity check: EECA states commercial-scale solar costs '$1500-2000 per kW of installed capacity', so the 30 kWp system is roughly $45-60k all-up and a whole-system figure is NOT the figure to compare against; this band covers only mounting, one-third roof strengthening and the PS1. Allowances are $0 - every line is either a cited QV row or a fetched page. Confidence low: the two largest lines (rails and brackets) rest on QV proxies for items QV does not price, and the rail length, bracket count and design hours are my assumptions, not published.

Working estimate band for a 30kWp/60-panel/120m2 array: proprietary rail mounting system (cited NZ vendor prices + install allowance), supplementary purlins and cleats to one third of footprint (QV rows), and structural engineer wind/uplift design + PS1 (cited NZ rate schedule + estimated hours). GST exclusive, excludes prelims and margin, PV/electrical, roofing work, scaffolding and consent fees. Mounting system is the weakest link: QV publishes nothing for solar mounting, so it rests on retail NZ vendor pricing plus an inferred rail/clamp density and an installation allowance.

band.unit: sum for the whole array (30 kWp, 60 panels, ~120 m2, Auckland, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Sum of five distinct lines with no double counting: mounting hardware 9,128-10,955 + mounting labour 2,439-4,878 = mounting system 11,567-15,833; supplementary purlins 1,081-1,737 + purlin bolts 190-379 = strengthening 1,271-2,116; design and PS1 899-1,615. Exact sums 13,737-19,564 (rounded 13,700-19,600), i.e. about $457-$653 per kWp. All rates GST exclusive except the retail kit price, which was converted by dividing the kit count by 1.15. Excludes preliminaries, margin, scaffolding/edge protection, electrical work and consent fees per the fixed scope. Cross-check: racking/mounting is commonly 10-25% of a solar system's cost and a 30 kW metal-roof system is quoted around $50,000 inc GST fully installed, implying roughly $4,350-$10,870 ex-GST for racking - the mounting line here is conservative-high because it is built from retail list rather than dealer pricing. Confidence low: the largest line rests on a retail kit price for a residential-grade system and estimated labour hours, so replace it with two dealer quotes before the band is relied on.

band.unit: sum for the whole 30 kWp / 60-panel array structural scope (mounting system, strengthening, design and PS1), NZD GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of components, GST exclusive: mounting hardware 7,304-12,783 (published price is GST inclusive and has been divided by 1.15) + mounting installation labour 2,378-4,755 + supplementary purlins 1,384-2,422 + purlin bolts 783-1,392 + structural design 3,600-5,600 + PS1 600-1,500 = 16,049-28,452. Split for review: mounting system 9,680-17,540; strengthening 2,167-3,815; design and PS1 4,200-7,100. Equivalent to roughly $535-950 per kW of array capacity. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, PV modules, inverters, cabling and electrical work, roof sheet replacement/repair/recoating, scaffolding and edge protection, and consent fees. Confidence is low because the proprietary rail system is priced from a single vendor page (retail, penetrating L-feet kit standing in for engineered non-penetrating rib clamps) and because the design hours are an estimate rather than a published fee.
